text:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding sample app fails for me after auth change. It gets into an infinite retry loop when the token env var is missing.

maya: Repro steps: clone repo, set REDWOOD_API_KEY to empty, run `npm start`. App keeps retrying with 401s.

raj: ugh, sorry about that. That readme still shows `REDWOOD_KEY` in examples, while the SDK now expects `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Copy/paste mismatch.

sam: Is the loop coming from our retry middleware or the sample app's wrapper?

maya: Looks like the app catches errors and re-schedules a call inside setInterval on auth error. So it just keeps hammering. Short snippet from logs:

```
401 Unauthorized - invalid api key
retrying request in 1000ms
401 Unauthorized - invalid api key
retrying request in 1000ms
```

lisa: This is a good example of docs drift causing an operational bug. We should fix README and also change sample to bail on persistent 401s.

raj: Agreed. Plan: (1) update README env var to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, (2) add guard in sample app to stop after 3 consecutive 401s + surface a warning, (3) add a small integration test to catch env var name mismatch.

maya: I'll open a tiny PR for the README and sample change. Want to include a short note in the quickstart: "If you see repeated 401s, check your REDWOOD_API_KEY env var and verify it's set to a valid key."

sam: Can we also add a lint step in CI that runs `node examples/status-check.js` which returns non-zero if the example app can't authenticate within 5s? That would catch copy/paste auth drift earlier.

raj: +1. We should keep it lightweight. Maybe run it only on merges to main and on release branch.

lisa: Also flagging potential UX improvement: onboarding page still shows fetch-style snippet that doesn't include the new `headers` shape for function calling. Small docs follow-up item.

devex-bot: Reminder — create ticket in JIRA: DEVEX-521 auth-sample-retry-loop and assign to maya.

maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/842 — updates env var names and stops retry after 3 auth failures. Added a note in README and a tiny example test.

raj: Reviewing now. Small nit: change `process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || ''` to `String(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || '')` to avoid undefined flow in TS sample.

sam: approved locally, running CI.

lisa: Thanks all. Once merged, can someone cherry-pick README line into the docs site (docs/quickstart) — I can do it if PR lands before EOD. :rocket:

maya: Will merge once CI green. Left a short test for the retry logic.

raj: After merge, I'll add the CI quick check to the repo's workflow.

sam: CI passed and merged. Closing the loop. :tada:
